arguments.title: Fill finite heap proofs
arguments.code:
var helpers = `
Lemma finite_trans (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  (P |-- Q) -> (Q |-- R) -> (P |-- R).
Proof. intros H K m HP; apply K, H, HP. Qed.
Lemma finite_frame (P Q R S : model -> Prop) :
  (P |-- R) -> (Q |-- S) -> (P ** Q |-- R ** S).
Proof.
  intros H K m [a [b [J [HP HQ]]]].
  exists a, b; split; [exact J|split; [apply H|apply K]; assumption].
Qed.
Lemma finite_swap (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  (P ** (Q ** R) |-- Q ** (P ** R)).
Proof.
  intros m [a [bc [J [HP [b [c [K [HQ HR]]]]]]]].
  destruct (join_assoc b c a bc m K (join_comm _ _ _ J))
    as [ca [L M]].
  exists b, ca; split; [exact M|split; [exact HQ|]].
  exists a, c; split; [apply join_comm; exact L|auto].
Qed.
Lemma finite_assoc (P Q R : model -> Prop) :
  ((P ** Q) ** R |-- P ** (Q ** R)).
Proof.
  intros m [ab [c [J [[a [b [K [HP HQ]]]] HR]]]].
  destruct (join_assoc a b c ab m K J) as [bc [L M]].
  exists a, bc; split; [exact M|split; [exact HP|]].
  exists b, c; auto.
Qed.
Lemma finite_unit (P : model -> Prop) : P |-- P ** emp.
Proof.
  intros m HP. destruct (unit_join m) as [u [U J]].
  exists m, u; split; [exact J|split; assumption].
Qed.
Ltac finite_right :=
  lazymatch goal with
  | |- (?P ** ?Q) ** ?R |-- ?T =>
      eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_assoc|finite_right]
  | |- ?P ** ?Q |-- ?T =>
      first [unify (P ** Q) T; intros ? H; exact H |
        eapply finite_trans;
        [apply finite_frame; [intros ? H; exact H|finite_right]|]]
  | |- ?P |-- ?P => intros ? H; exact H
  end.
Ltac finite_take :=
  lazymatch goal with
  | |- ?P ** ?Q |-- ?P ** _ => intros ? H; exact H
  | |- (?A ** ?B) ** ?C |-- _ =>
      eapply finite_trans; [apply finite_assoc|finite_take]
  | |- ?A ** ?B |-- ?P ** _ =>
      eapply finite_trans;
      [apply finite_frame; [intros ? H; exact H|finite_take]|
       apply finite_swap]
  | |- ?P |-- ?P ** _ => apply finite_unit
  end.
Ltac finite_heap :=
  first [intros ? H; exact H |
    lazymatch goal with
    | |- _ |-- ?P ** ?Q =>
      eapply finite_trans; [finite_take|
        apply finite_frame; [intros ? H; exact H|finite_heap]]
    | |- _ => intros ? H; repeat split; try reflexivity; exact H
    end].
Ltac finite_reduce :=
  cbn [CharArray.seg CharArray.full CharArray.undef_full
       CharArray.undef_seg store_array store_undef_array
       store_array_rec store_undef_array_rec repeat_Z
       StoreCharAsElement.storeA StoreCharAsElement.undefstoreA
       StoreCharAsElement.sizeA];
  rewrite ?sizeof_char; cbn.
`;
candidate = candidate.replace('\n\nTheorem', '\n'+helpers+'\nTheorem');
candidate = candidate.replace(/Theorem (resolved_([^ :]+)) : ([^.]+\.[^.]*)\.\nProof\. Admitted\./g, (whole,name,short,target)=> { var proof; var n=short.match(/entail_wit_(\d+)/)?.[1]; if(short.endsWith('split_goal_1')) proof='unfold '+target+'; intros ? H; reflexivity.'; else if(short.endsWith('split_goal_spatial')) proof='unfold '+target+'; finite_reduce; finite_heap.'; else if(n) proof='unfold '+target+'; right; exact resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_'+n+'_split_goal_spatial.'; else proof='unfold '+target+'; left; intros; subst;\n  eapply finite_trans with (Q := CharArray.full 4096 8 (repeat_Z 0 8));\n  [finite_reduce; finite_heap|intros m H; exists (repeat_Z 0 8); exact H].'; if(n==='9'&&!short.includes('split')) proof='unfold '+target+'; right; intros m H; split;\n  [reflexivity|apply resolved_init_array2_entail_wit_9_split_goal_spatial; exact H].'; return 'Theorem '+name+' : '+target+'.\nProof. '+proof+' Qed.'; });
await fs.writeFile('Candidate.v',candidate); console.log(candidate);
